confirmedFindings.title: Missing composite index (org_id, status, timestamp DESC) for high-frequency filter query
confirmedFindings.body: High-frequency dashboard queries filter on (org_id, status) and sort by timestamp DESC. A single-column index on org_id requires expensive row filtering and in-memory sort under high event volume.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Create a composite index matching query predicate and sort order: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_metric_events_composite ON metric_events(org_id, status, timestamp DESC);
